registered_before: Any learned-forward or task test of quaternion sign flip in this project

fixed_protocol.goal: open the middle drawer of the cabinet

intervention: Copy the model input observation; negate all four xyzw quaternion coordinates only. Never normalize. Leave simulator/controller, images, position, gripper, Goal and all weights untouched. Native proposal/future/value read the same transformed observation.
canonicalization: First nonzero coordinate in fixed x,y,z,w order must be positive; tie order fixed before outcomes. Applies equally to clean and flipped input.
training_support_limit: Official quaternion x min=0.2902947962284088 max=0.9999998807907104; negative-sign representation lies outside this training range. This is physically equivalent representation robustness, not a small numerical or in-support perturbation.
stop_rule: Run exactly these eight episodes unless a technical/clean-equivalence gate fails. No expansion if no task harm or N1/N2 share OOD failure. No adaptive sign schedule or initial-state selection.
promotion_rule: Only if N2 clean and sign_flip_then_x_canonical succeed, N2 sign_flip fails, and N1 sign_flip succeeds: Go only to a separate fixed-candidate forecast/direct-value attribution test. N1/N2 difference alone does not prove future mediation.
success_source: Native LIBERO check_success, first success or done stop, max300 physical controls.
clean_equivalence: Compare entire native trace, all candidate scores/selected actions and future RMS, initial/final simulator arrays, and PNGs against pre-existing successful N1/N2 Task0 Init0.
clean_cost: Actually execute clean_x_canonical under each N and compare success and steps to the executed clean arm.
scope: One initial state, eight paired arms; no independent validation, CI, population claim or established novelty.
Input-channel write permission is assumed; no deployed remote exploit demonstrated.
Published torch compatibility backend, not full Transformer Engine kernel parity.
